about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Who is Bin Hadi?
about.body: We are Bin Hadi Car Rental, and we are glad to welcome you to our community of car lovers and professionals. We strive to create an outstanding experience that combines quality and trust, through a fleet of more than 4,000 cars across 16 branches throughout the Kingdom. We offer a range of rental services including daily and long-term rental, chauffeur service, lease-to-own and rental to GCC countries. Our team of experts is ready to serve you around the clock — enjoy your journey with Bin Hadi!

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Have a question? Our team is ready to help!

types.a: We offer daily, weekly and monthly rental, long-term leasing, chauffeur service, lease-to-own, and rental to GCC countries.

booking.q: How can I book a car?
booking.a: Choose the city, pick-up date and time in the search bar, pick a car and tap Details to complete your booking in a few steps.

insurance.a: Yes, all our cars carry comprehensive insurance, and you can add extra coverage while booking.

branches.a: We have 16 branches across the Kingdom’s main airports and cities, including King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh.

nonSaudi.a: Yes, residents and visitors can rent with a valid ID and an approved driving licence.

payment.a: We accept bank cards, mada and Apple Pay, as well as cash at the branch.

terms.metaDescription: Terms and conditions for using Bin Hadi Car Rental services.

sections.title: Clause 1
paragraphs: We place the utmost importance on the privacy of your data. Personal information such as your name, mobile number and email is collected to improve your experience and provide the requested services accurately and professionally. We use advanced encryption to protect your data from any breach or unauthorised access, in line with internationally recognised cybersecurity standards.

You may at any time request the correction or deletion of your personal data, or unsubscribe from email services, by contacting our support team by email or through your account dashboard. We may update this policy periodically, so we recommend reviewing it regularly to stay informed of the latest changes in how we handle and protect your personal information.

sections.title: Clause 2
paragraphs: Your personal data is used to provide the services and products you request, improve the user experience and tailor content to your interests, and contact you about updates and exclusive offers after obtaining your prior consent. We also use data for statistical analysis and performance improvement by studying usage patterns and visitor behaviour, without linking these analyses to your direct personal identity.

We do not share your personal data with third parties except when it is necessary to provide the service, provided those parties adhere to the same protection standards, or when disclosure is required by a court order or applicable law in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. In all cases, data is transferred over secure, fully encrypted channels in accordance with personal data protection regulations.

We use cookies to improve site performance and remember your preferences on future visits. You can control cookie settings from your browser at any time, or block them entirely, although this may affect some site features. For more information on how we use cookies, contact our support team, available around the clock to answer all your questions.
